facts.fact: Before the public reading Neela sends Muthu's two guards out to the apron to face the road; Thilak and Kuttu guard Chathu on the cook-house step, so only the forty and Devan hear the pages.
Pavi rode back from the cairn camp at first light on the reading day and is present in the yard.
Unni rode with Muthu's thirty and watched him write his last month letter; Rema's escort had already left by the goat path.
The Resin House kennel aisle has forty-two cages in a single row, forty-one filled. Neela reads eighty-two pages in the day: the forty, Vellan's, and forty-one kennel pages.
